posts.title: 텔레그램 대화 백업하는 방법 - 설치 없이 브라우저에서 zip으로 내보내기
posts.description: 텔레그램 공식 내보내기와 달리 기간 지정·특정 방 선택·말풍선 보기·익명 처리가 가능한 브라우저 백업 도구를 소개합니다. 설치 없이 바로 쓰고 서버를 거치지 않아 로그인 정보가 외부로 나가지 않습니다.

posts.title: Fixing Naver Map Open API Authentication Failed (200): Change ncpClientId to ncpKeyId
posts.description: This post explains the cause of the Authentication Failed (200) error in Naver Map Open API. Confirm that the parameter has changed from ncpClientId to ncpKeyId, and fix the authentication failure by updating the script URL.

posts.title: How to Issue a Free SSL Certificate on Synology DSM |
posts.description: A guide to issuing and auto-renewing a Let's Encrypt free SSL certificate on Synology DSM using acme.sh and Cloudflare DNS validation. Covers synology_dsm deploy-hook setup and troubleshooting 2FA and hostname errors.

posts.title: Supporting Multiple Languages on a Hugo Site
posts.description: Optimize a Hugo multilingual blog by configuring baseURL, sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, Open Graph, and meta descriptions, then prevent duplicate issues with hreflang and canonical tags plus slug and translationKey troubleshooting.

posts.title: age Usage Guide: Encrypt Team Secret Files with Recipients and Decrypt with Private Keys
posts.description: A guide to encrypting team secret files with public keys (recipients) and decrypting them with private keys using age. Covers key generation, recipients management, differences from GPG, and why re-encryption is needed when team members change.

posts.title: Terraform Practical Guide: Installation, plan/apply, AWS SSO & AssumeRole, State Backend
posts.description: Covers Terraform installation through the basic flow of init, plan, and apply along with project structure. Explains the difference between AWS SSO and AssumeRole for credentials, the backend concept for state sharing with an AWS (S3) example, minimum IAM permissions, and operational tips.

posts.title: Mac Office Activation Guide | Install LTSC with Volume License VL Serializer
posts.description: A step-by-step guide to installing and activating Microsoft Office on Mac using a volume license. Covers LTSC installer selection, VL Serializer application, and activation verification.

posts.title: How to Install Ollama and Build a Local LLM Server
posts.description: Learn how to run a local LLM on a Linux server with Ollama. This guide covers installation, external access configuration, model selection, and HTTP API call examples to set up your own personal AI server.

posts.title: 오라클 클라우드 Always Free A1 인스턴스 생성 방법 - 공인 IP 연결과 SSH 보안 설정
posts.description: Oracle Cloud Always Free A1(ARM) 인스턴스를 만드는 방법을 단계별로 정리합니다. 무료 스펙 선택부터 공인 IP 연결 SSH 키 설정 VCN Security List와 NSG로 SSH 22 포트 제한까지 포함합니다.

posts.title: Accessing Git remotes over SSH: from key generation to registration
posts.description: A complete walkthrough for connecting to Git remotes via SSH. Compare HTTPS vs SSH, generate Ed25519 keys, set proper chmod permissions, register the public key on GitHub/GitLab, and verify with ssh -T so you can eliminate authentication issues quickly.

posts.title: Completely removing leaked secrets from Git history with git filter-repo (force push and resync)
posts.description: Step-by-step procedure for wiping .env files, secrets, and tokens from Git history with git filter-repo. Define filter rules, validate the rewritten history, force-push the new graph, resync every collaborator, and review protected branch settings in one go.

posts.title: Clearing DNS Cache on Windows/Linux/macOS
posts.description: When DNS changes fail to appear, flush the cache on Windows, Linux, and macOS with ipconfig, resolvectl, and mDNSResponder commands, and check TTL and browser caches to diagnose propagation delays quickly.
